entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your magical connection to nature allows you to entice, fool, and misdirect plants and fungi as though they were people.

Prerequisites: Spell Focus (enchantment), Knowledge (nature) 6 ranks.

Benefit: A verdant spell affects plant creatures (even mindless plant creatures) as if they weren’t immune to mind-affecting effects, but it has no effect on other types of creatures. This feat works only on mind-affecting spells.

Level Increase: +2 (a verdant spell uses up a spell slot 2 levels higher than the spell’s actual level.)

Normal: Creatures of the plant type are immune to mind-affecting effects.
